h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.hypothesis: Parent H33 retains ~10% low-marginal-gain dots near the 2-3px collar and in low-geothermal-prior blocks; pruning them reduces FP-weighted denominator faster than TP loss.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.mechanism: DTI = T/(0.2(T+S-M)+0.8|G|); removing dots with credit m_self <0.2*DTI/(1-0.2*DTI) ~0.056 at DTI 0.28 improves score even if TP loss is small. Low-ranked dots are those with low p_oof and low q_oof (physics self-credit).
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan benches (1212/1298/1334m) and GeoDAWN E-W flight-line corrugations produce subparallel lineaments that pass gravity/RTP edge filters but lack tip-relay linkage; they dominate low-rank tail.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.predicted_sign_size: MODEL predicted live delta -0.008 (range -0.018 to +0.002). Small negative because parent already pruned to 0 within 2px; remaining low-rank dots still carry ~0.03-0.05 marginal credit via line-like truth clustering.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.falsifier: If live score rises >=+0.01 within 1 week, hypothesis falsified: low-rank tail contains undetected new-fault lineaments (e.g., blind relay breccia zones with weak surface expression).

h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.hypothesis: Parent under-samples high-prior fault-tip extensions and inter-step relay zones where physics+geodesic model scores 0.08-0.15 but NMS spacing excluded them; adding next-ranked 10% captures these relays.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.mechanism: Tip strike rays (Pollard & Segall 1987, 24px) and bilateral relay bridge tomography predict discrete undetected segments 0.5-2km beyond visible termini; Noisy-OR fusion gives p>0.12 and q~0.18 in 300m kernel, enough to cross DTI threshold for line-like truth.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.non_fault_mimic: Lateral alluvial geothermal outflow plumes and unfaulted pluton contacts can inflate GDR 2m temperature + resistivity without fault slip; they cluster near range-front but lack eikonal conductivity (w<0.06) and tip-path integral.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.predicted_sign_size: MODEL predicted live delta +0.004 (range -0.012 to +0.016). Small positive because added dots rank 37k-41k (p_oof ~0.09) sits near marginal threshold; if new faults are spatially sparse, FP penalty may dominate.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10plus-20261023-82673b.falsifier: If live score drops <=-0.015, falsified: added dots are dominantly non-fault geothermal noise (outflow, paleoshorelines) or parent's spacing already optimal; also check holdout PROXY: H33 hide-and-recover rose from 0.092 to 0.108 with similar +10% add (n=37654) but correlated only +0.54 with live.

h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.hypothesis: Mass-DTI elasticity is concave: doubling prune to 20% crosses into retaining only high-precision core (p_oof>0.25, q>0.22) but sacrifices recall on isolated blind faults where kernel halo is sole credit.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.mechanism: Dinkelbach CELF ranking shows marginal gain d(DTI)/dS ~ (M -0.2*DTI)/denominator; below 30k dots, each removed dot loses ~0.08 TP_w but saves 1.0 FP_w; net DTI change turns negative beyond 15% prune because private test chunks may contain dispersed low-density fault fabrics.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.non_fault_mimic: Same as m10minus plus 10m detrended-elevation scarps >15m that are actually fluvial knickpoints (chi>45) not seismogenic; they score high on lidar scarp feature but low on 60deg up-dip advection and MT clay-cap triad.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.predicted_sign_size: MODEL predicted live delta -0.018 (range -0.030 to -0.005). Moderate negative confirms parent near optimal mass; if positive, suggests parent over-dense and private truth is sparser than public catalogue.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm20minus-20261023-6c733.falsifier: If live score improves >=+0.01, mass hypothesis inverted: private new-fault density is lower than holdout (SW quadrant bias) and current 0.7-0.85% footprint density is excessive; would motivate MASS -30% test.

h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.hypothesis: At a fixed dot count, raising local dot density on the parent's most confident km-scale clusters raises the metric more than the relocation costs, because the metric's false-positive term is sum_x p(x)(1 - max_g k): a dot welded next to an already-covering dot pays almost no penalty (0.2(1 - k) ~ 0.07 at 1 px) while a dot in an empty km block pays the full 0.2. Mass moved out of the coldest blocks therefore relieves denominator weight that the parent was still paying.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.mechanism: DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(n - M) + 0.8|G|) with n fixed at 37654. Each move changes the denominator by 0.2(t_add - t_rm + m_rm - m_add). Donors are drawn from the coldest 1 km blocks (mean block prior 0.75 dots/km2) where m_rm ~ 0; receivers land in blocks with mean prior 2.54 dots/km2 at 1.04 px from a surviving host, so m_add is inherited from the host's proximity to truth. No new pixels enter the catalogue collar and no block is emptied.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan benches and GeoDAWN E-W flight-line corrugation both survive edge filters and pack into km-scale bands; welding dots onto them raises M only if the host is actually near truth, so a mimic shows up as a null (m_add ~ 0), not a false gain. Conversely, alluvial geothermal outflow along range fronts forms km-scale clusters with no fault slip, which would produce a real m_add but nothing in T.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.predicted_sign_size: MODEL +0.011 live, scenario range [-0.002, +0.030]. Point scenario: m_add 0.30, t_rm 0.02, m_rm 0.02, t_add = 0.2 m_add, calibrated on the two CLAIM pairs (0.2778 / 0.2600). The sign is not guaranteed: at m_add <= 0.15 and t_rm >= 0.02 the recall lost from the donors dominates.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.confounder: CV excursion. Under every estimator tried, R0 sits at 0.62 (raw 1 km counts, occupied blocks) / 0.48 (5 km-smoothed density); these variants push it to 1.02-1.36 / 0.67-1.07, far outside the 0.51-0.59 band the brief quotes for the best files. If that band is causal and not an artefact of the estimator, the live change should be negative even though the algebra predicts positive. That is the cleanest way to falsify the folklore.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.falsifier: Live change <= -0.010: concentration past the parent costs real recall, the cold-tail donors were catching isolated blind faults, and the axis is closed. Live change in (-0.010, +0.010): the metric's redundancy credit is too small to matter at 10-20 % and the axis is closed as sub-noise at this dose. Live change >= +0.010 with the 20 % move > 10 % move: mechanism confirmed, scale the dose and combine with the best MASS setting next session.
